offers.name: Volza
offers.summary: A global trade intelligence platform for researching shipment data, buyers, suppliers, products and markets.
offers.best_for: Import-export businesses, sourcing teams, market researchers and B2B sales teams validating international demand.
offers.pricing_note: Plans and pricing can change; verify the current options on Volza before subscribing.
offers.why_consider: Volza is most useful when a team needs evidence about real cross-border trade activity rather than another general-purpose AI assistant.
offers.watch_out: This is a specialist business-data product. Confirm that its country, product and shipment coverage matches your research workflow before choosing a plan.
use_cases: Find and compare potential international buyers or suppliers
Research shipment activity for a product or market
Support sourcing, market-entry and B2B prospecting decisions

offers.name: Descript
offers.summary: An AI-assisted workspace for editing video and audio, transcribing recordings, capturing screens and producing reusable clips.
offers.best_for: Creators, podcasters, educators and marketing teams that prefer editing recorded media through a text-led workflow.
offers.pricing_note: Affiliate eligibility applies to qualifying new subscriptions; verify current plans and features on Descript.
offers.why_consider: Descript combines transcription and media editing in one workflow, which can reduce context switching for teams producing spoken-word and video content.
offers.watch_out: Check export, collaboration and AI-usage limits for the plan you are considering. Product capabilities and eligible affiliate plans can change.
use_cases: Edit podcasts and interviews from their transcripts
Turn long recordings into shorter social clips
Record screens and refine narration in one workspace

offers.name: Runpod
offers.summary: Cloud GPU infrastructure for teams running AI workloads through on-demand pods and serverless endpoints.
offers.best_for: Developers and technical teams deploying inference, training or other GPU-intensive AI workloads.
offers.pricing_note: Usage-based pricing varies by compute choice; verify current availability and rates on Runpod.
offers.why_consider: Runpod is relevant when a project needs configurable GPU capacity without owning or maintaining the underlying hardware.
offers.watch_out: Publication is paused until the separate Runpod account requirement is verified. Workload cost, regional availability and operational requirements should also be tested first.
use_cases: Provision temporary compute for experiments or training
Deploy serverless endpoints for production AI workloads
